title: SearchResult
description: Full response returned by Cloud Run POST /ai/search and POST /ai/turn. This is the unified response type the spec defines in §12. The browser drawer renders all groups from a single response object. Never return free text or product HTML — all human-visible text is in ai_message and product card fields only.

request_id.description: Echoed from the request. Enables client-side deduplication.

intent.description: Gemini's parsed intent. null only when source is 'fallback_local' and Gemini was unreachable.

source.description: cloud_ai = full Gemini path; cloud_provisional = fast index, no Gemini; fallback_local = pgvector/WC without Cloud Run; fallback_wc = native WordPress WP_Query; disabled = plugin off. The UI must display the fallback indicator when source is not 'cloud_ai'.

ai_message.description: Short, shopper-visible message from Gemini about what it understood and found. e.g. 'מצאתי גבינות שמתאימות לאירוח, כולל אפשרויות במחיר נוח.' Required when source is cloud_ai. null for all other sources. Plain text only — no HTML or Markdown.

product_groups.description: Ordered product groups. Each group has a label and a list of products. For simple queries there is usually one group. For recipe/occasion queries the server may return multiple groups (main, sides, condiments).

label.description: Short group label shown to the shopper. e.g. 'עיקריות', 'תוספות', 'מבצע השבוע'. Max 50 chars.

group_note.description: Optional short note about this group e.g. 'אלה יכולים להתאים יחד'. Plain text only.

total.description: Total matching products in this group (may exceed products array length if paginated).

substitute_groups.description: Substitute product groups. Present only when a primary product is out of stock or when the user requests alternatives. Each substitute group links back to the product it substitutes.

intro.description: Short intro e.g. 'המוצר הזה חסר כרגע, אבל מצאתי אפשרויות דומות.' Plain text.

promotions.description: Active promotions relevant to the returned products. Presented to the user AFTER product relevance is established — never instead of relevant products.

followup_actions.description: Context-aware follow-up options. Max 5. Each is a short label that becomes a /ai/turn request when tapped. Derived from the current result context — not generic. e.g. 'תראה משהו זול יותר', 'רק מוצרים במבצע', 'מצא לי תחליפים'.

label.description: Short Hebrew label shown as a button.

intent_hint.description: Machine-readable intent used by the server to route the turn request.

suggested_navigation.description: If Gemini determines the user would be better served by a category page or section, this field carries the navigation instruction. The browser shows it as an optional 'Browse all X' link, never auto-navigates.

url.description: Full store-relative URL. Constructed server-side — never model-invented.

pending_cart_actions.description: Cart-add instructions prepared by request_cart_action tool calls during this response. The browser must present each as a confirmation prompt before executing. Never auto-execute.

processing_metadata.description: Server-side timing and routing metadata. Stripped from shopper-facing responses; included in debug mode only.

tool_calls.description: Number of function-calling tool invocations during this request.

latency_ms.description: Total server-side latency in milliseconds from request received to response serialized.
